The network: the input is a one-hot number a (0 to 31), a one-hot number b (0 to 31) and a one-hot skill (4 skills), concatenated in that order. Then l1 (width 48), silu, l2 (width 48), silu, l3 (63 outputs, read as a class from 0 to 62). The four skills follow secret rules: each maps (a, b) to a class, and nobody will tell you the rules. You do not get the training examples.

Training: Adam at learning rate 0.003, 64 examples per skill per step, 1500 steps in all, pausing every 150 steps up to step 600. The batches are fixed in advance and stay the same whatever you do. Training continues from your edited weights and keeps the optimizer's state.

Goal: the highest accuracy on all four skills at step 1500, on pairs (a, b) the network never trained on. 30% of pairs are held out. You never see that score, and there are no edits after step 600: from step 600 to step 1500 training runs on its own with the speeds you last set.
